name: Echo of Aessina summons its Echo of Aessina guardian (#7128)
contract: Issue #7128: using the Echo of Aessina trinket 451047 plays the cast but nothing is summoned. Its on-use spell 901521 has a SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with MiscValue 901521 and SummonProperties 61 (ally guardian) for 15 seconds; no creature_template defined 901521, so Map::SummonCreature failed in Creature::Create. The captured AscensionDB WDB row (creaturecache, 2026-09-04) names 901521 'Echo of Aessina', a beast with display 10045. Expected: after the trinket is used, the Starcaller owns one living Echo of Aessina 901521 with display 10045.

steps.label: On-use trinkets work only while equipped
Equipping an on-use trinket starts its 30 second item cooldown
SETUP: the trinket casts Echo of Aessina
The cast summons one Echo of Aessina
The Echo shows the WDB display 10045
